Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class SystemInfoService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.SystemInfoService
public final class SystemInfoService extends Object
Aggregate, read-only system information for the control center's System/About panel and the CPU/memory widgets.

Everything is read from /proc, /sys, /etc/os-release and File space queries - no privileges and no external commands required (a couple of environment variables are consulted for the session type). Values that cannot be determined come back as empty/zero rather than throwing.
